description_en: Creates a policy that applies unified settings to cloud phones. These settings include features such as network redirection, watermarks, resolution, and the clipboard
description_zh: 创建策略。策略用于对云手机进行统一的设置，例如网络重定向策略、水印、分辨率、剪贴板等功能设置
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic create-policy-group --html5-file-transfer off --local-drive off --policy-group-name Default_policy --camera-redirect off --clipboard readwrite --resolution-height 1280 --resolution-width 720 --lock-resolution off --net-redirect-policy '{"ProxyUserName":"username","Port":"1145","NetRedirect":"off","ProxyPassword":"password","ProxyType":"socks5","Rules":[{"Target":"0.baidu.com","RuleType":"domain"}],"HostAddr":"47.100.XX.XX","CustomProxy":"off"}' --policy-type Instance --watermark '{"WatermarkFontSize":12,"WatermarkTransparencyValue":25,"WatermarkSwitch":"off","WatermarkColor":0,"WatermarkTypes":["Username"],"WatermarkCustomText":"custom_text"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePolicyGroup
